passage:
The swimming pool was closed for repairs all summer. Many children were disappointed because it was the coolest place in town.
The community center decided to offer free indoor activities instead. There were dance lessons, board games, painting classes, and movie afternoons.
At first, children joined because they had no pool. Later, many discovered new interests. A boy who loved swimming found that he also liked chess. A girl who missed diving started painting fish.
When the pool reopened, everyone was happy. But the indoor activities stayed on the schedule.
The closed pool had seemed like only bad news. It became the reason the town found more ways for children to spend summer days.
